def _weak_batch(self, n, k):
    hard = [i for i in range(n) if i % 3 == 0]
    chosen = hard[:k]
    if len(chosen) < k:
        chosen_set = set(chosen)
        chosen += [i for i in range(n) if i not in chosen_set][: k - len(chosen)]
    return chosen
